# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as pale, spiritual-looking, golden, and fair. She has hair like spun gold and carries herself with elegance.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious, yet full of mischief, pranks, and fun. She expresses her poetic thoughts openly and appreciatively in nature and friendship.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c13 P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011), [v2 c13 P13](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0013), [v2 c13 P75](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0075)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley, joining a close circle of thoughtful and ambitious friends. After graduating, she accepted a teaching position at Carmody School. During her time in the area, she joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and contributed a paper at one of their meetings. In the spring, she went on a memorable woodland outing with Anne, Diana, and Jane. Later, she brought her famous aunt, Mrs. Charlotte E. Morgan, to visit Anne at Green Gables. She eventually accepted the teaching position at her home school, leaving Carmody.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c6 P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_
